description: Central registry of every Bee diagnostic code. Single source of truth for all E/W codes across /spec and /tutorial. Register a new code here before using it; if a code collides with a registered one, bump the new code to the next free slot in its module block and re-register.

conventions.E: hard error (fatal; halts the build or traps at runtime unless handled)
conventions.W: soft warning (non-fatal; logged to stderr, does not change exit status)
conventions.block_rule: module <dd> → E<dd>xx, where <dd> is the module's leading digit (01→E01, 02→E02, ... 14→E14).
conventions.memory_block: module 00 (memory model) has no natural E00xx block (E00xx is reserved for global/deprecation codes), so memory uses E08xx, the first free block (modules skip 08/09 between 07 and 10).
conventions.collision_policy: If a proposed code already exists in this registry, the newer/less-canonical use must be bumped to the next free code in its module block and registered here. Never silently reuse an occupied code with different semantics.
conventions.register_first: Never inject a diagnostic table into /spec or /tutorial before the codes are registered here.

global.note: Cross-cutting codes shared by every module. Up-scope targets for Phase 7.2 deprecation hardening.

E0009.name: HardSyntaxError
E0009.condition: Upscope target for deprecated symbols/keywords once Phase 7.2 migration completes (replaces E0010/E0011 as hard).
E0009.resolution: Rewrite using the canonical ratified form.

E0010.name: DeprecatedSymbol/DeprecatedKeyword
E0010.resolution: Replace with the canonical form; non-fatal until Phase 7.2 hardens to E0009.

E0011.name: DeprecatedSymbol 'using'
E0011.condition: Legacy 'using' / 'using:' postfix on io_stmt or rule call (D6).
E0011.resolution: Use curried named-argument call form (sep: ...); non-fatal until hardened to E0009.

W0901.name: UnrecognizedStatement
W0901.condition: Parser reached a token stream with no statements produced; soft warning attached to parser error surface.
W0901.resolution: Author statements that the rigid syntax gate recognizes.

00-memory-model.collision_note: Bumped from E04xx to E08xx on 2026-09-14 to resolve the E04xx block overload with spec/04-structure (which retains E0401-E0406).

E0801.name: AccessAfterZap
E0801.condition: Read or write of an identifier after a 'zap' statement in the same control-flow graph.
E0801.resolution: Compile-time fatal error with source line location; runtime 'Panic: UseAfterZap' under -d.

E0802.name: RegionEscape
E0802.condition: Pointer escapes a Region Arena into an outer scope.
E0802.resolution: Compiler automatically promotes the allocation from Region to ARC Heap.

E0803.name: ArcCycleLeak
E0803.condition: Unhandled cycle in an ARC structure.
E0803.resolution: Static lifetime analysis, or runtime leak warning under -d.

E0804.name: CrossThreadUnsharedMutation
E0804.condition: Cross-thread mutation of an unshared reference.

E0101.name: UTF8BomMarker
E0101.condition: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM marker at source start.
E0101.resolution: Strip the BOM from the source header.

E0103.name: InvalidEscapeSequence
E0103.condition: Invalid escape sequence in a string literal.

E0104.name: SingleLetterUppercaseIdentifier
E0104.resolution: Use a lowercase start or a multi-letter type identifier.

E0105.name: UnterminatedStringOrMarkup
E0105.condition: Unterminated string literal or markup block.
E0105.resolution: Check closing quotes or the matching markup tag.

E0201.name: IndentationMismatch
E0201.condition: Statement not aligned to the 2-space offset boundary.
E0201.resolution: Re-indent to the canonical 2-space block depth.

E0202.name: UnboundVariable
E0202.condition: Mutation of a variable without a prior 'new' declaration.

E0204.name: InvalidCloneOperation
E0204.condition: Using the '::' clone operator on a non-clonable primitive.
E0204.resolution: Use ':=' or restrict '::' to boxed/object targets.

E0205.name: LabelMismatch
E0205.condition: Closing label on 'done' does not match the opening header label.
E0205.resolution: Align 'done' label with the block header label.

E0206.name: InvalidJumpContext
E0206.condition: 'next', 'stop', or 'redo' used outside a loop body.
E0206.resolution: Move the jump inside a loop (D14/D15).

E0301.name: UndeclaredRule
E0301.condition: Rule invoked prior to definition or forward declaration.
E0301.resolution: Define or forward-declare the rule first.

W0301.name: AssertionWarning
W0301.condition: Assertion failed in an 'assert' contract clause.
W0301.resolution: Logged to stderr; review the asserted invariant.

E0303.name: ExpectationFailed
E0303.condition: Expectation failed in an 'expect' contract clause or body statement.

E0304.name: MultiResultInExpression
E0304.condition: Multi-result rule used inside an arithmetic expression tree.
E0304.resolution: Call the rule at statement level and deconstruct its results.

E0305.name: MissingReturnTerminator
E0305.condition: Rule block does not end with an aligned 'return;'.

E0306.name: SignatureMismatch
E0306.condition: Forward declaration does not match the rule implementation signature.

E0307.name: MissingNamedArgument
E0307.condition: Call site omits a required named-parameter slot binding with no default (D6).
E0307.resolution: Supply the named argument at the call site.

W0308.name: NamedSlotIgnored
W0308.condition: Curried '(...)' list appended where the rule declares no named slot (D6).

E0309.name: UnknownNamedArgument
E0309.condition: Call site names an identifier not present in the rule's declared named slot (D6).

04-structure.retains: Retains the canonical E04xx block after memory was bumped to E08xx on 2026-09-14.

E0401.name: MainModuleRedefinition
E0401.condition: Secondary or library module contains 'rule main'.

E0402.name: PrivateMemberAccess
E0402.condition: Access to an unexported member (missing '.' prefix).
E0402.resolution: Export the member with a '.' prefix or access within module.

E0403.name: ModuleNotFound
E0403.condition: Module file missing from the search path ($pro_mod, $pro_lib, $bee_lib).
E0403.resolution: Place the module in a configured search path.

E0405.name: MainImportForbidden
E0405.condition: Attempt to load 'main.bee' via a 'use' directive.
E0405.resolution: Do not import the entry module.

E0406.name: UnsynchronizedWorker
E0406.condition: Scope exited with pending 'begin' threads prior to a 'wait' barrier.
E0406.resolution: Add a 'wait' barrier before scope exit. (Semantic twin of E1201 in concurrency; retained here for module-level structure completeness.)

E0501.name: TypeMismatch
E0501.condition: Assigned value violates the static type boundary.
E0501.resolution: Cast or fix the value to the declared type.

E0502.name: InvalidTypeCast
E0502.condition: Incompatible explicit cast with the ':>' operator.
E0502.resolution: Use a lossless cast between compatible types.

E0503.name: DomainOutOfBounds
E0503.condition: Assigned literal falls outside a constrained range/domain.
E0503.resolution: Constrain the value to the declared domain.

E0504.name: RationalOverflow
E0504.condition: Value exceeds the maximum capacity of a Q(m.n) container.

E0505.name: SingleLetterTypeReserved
E0505.condition: User type identifier uses a reserved single uppercase Latin letter.
E0505.resolution: Choose a non-reserved name or a multi-letter type.

E0601.name: AbstractMethodUnimplemented
E0601.condition: Concrete class fails to supply a body for an inherited abstract method.
E0601.resolution: Implement the abstract method in the concrete class.

E0602.name: PrivatePropertyAccess
E0602.condition: Access to a property without the '.' or 'self.' export prefix.
E0602.resolution: Export the property or access via 'self.'.

E0603.name: SuperConstructorMissing
E0603.condition: Derived constructor fails to execute a 'super(...)' call.

E0604.name: CyclicInheritance
E0604.condition: Class hierarchy contains a circular inheritance loop.

E0605.name: UnknownMemberKey
E0605.condition: Accessing a dynamic key that does not exist in an object dictionary.
E0605.resolution: Guard the key with a membership check.

E0606.name: InvalidTraitApplication
E0606.condition: Trait applied to an incompatible target type.
E0606.resolution: Apply the trait only to compatible types.

E0701.name: RuleCallInLambda
E0701.condition: Lambda attempts to invoke a stateful rule.
E0701.resolution: Use only pure lambdas inside a lambda; hoist the rule call out.

E0702.name: SideEffectInLambda
E0702.condition: Lambda contains I/O or variable mutation.

E0703.name: LambdaTypeMismatch
E0703.condition: Passed lambda signature does not match the expected 'L' parameter.
E0703.resolution: Align the lambda signature with the 'L' type descriptor.

E0704.name: UnboundLambdaVariable
E0704.condition: Lambda references an outer variable not in scope inside the lambda frame.
E0704.resolution: Pass needed values as lambda parameters.

E0705.name: StateDeclarationInLambda
E0705.condition: Use of 'new', 'let', or 'alter' inside a lambda.
E0705.resolution: Move state declarations outside the lambda.

E1001.name: IndexOutOfBounds
E1001.condition: Index less than 1 or greater than the collection length '$'.

E1002.name: DuplicateSetKey
E1002.condition: Insertion of a duplicate key/element into Set/Map.

E1004.name: TypeIncompatibleCollection
E1004.condition: Value type does not match the declared collection element type.
E1004.resolution: Cast the value or change the element type.

E1005.name: InvalidSetAlgebra
E1005.condition: Set operator ('∩','∪') applied to a non-set type.
E1005.resolution: Use set operators only on sets.

E1101.name: UnboxingTypeMismatch
E1101.condition: Unboxing a reference into an incompatible scalar type.

E1102.name: InvalidQuantifierDomain
E1102.condition: Quantifier applied to a non-collection operand.

E1103.name: PipelineStepIncompatible
E1103.condition: Output type of a pipeline step does not match the next step's input.
E1103.resolution: Insert an adapting step into the pipeline.

E1104.name: DeconstructionMismatch
E1104.condition: Number of targets exceeds collection elements without a '*' tail.
E1104.resolution: Add a '*' tail or reduce targets.

E1105.name: InvalidMatrixSlice
E1105.condition: Dimension wildcard '*' used on a non-matrix or invalid rank.
E1105.resolution: Use '*' only on valid matrix ranks.

E1106.name: NonBoxedAssignment
E1106.condition: Reference assignment ':=' on an unboxed value.

E1201.name: UnsynchronizedWorker
E1201.condition: Scope exited with pending 'begin' threads prior to a 'wait' barrier.
E1201.resolution: Add a 'wait' barrier before scope exit. (Canonical working code; twin of E0406 in structure.)

E1202.name: DataRaceAttempt
E1202.condition: Direct cross-thread mutation without a '+>' reduction channel.

E1203.name: CoroutinesChannelClosed
E1203.condition: 'yield var << task' on a closed or finished coroutine.
E1203.resolution: Re-open the channel or check coroutine state.

E1204.name: WorkerPanicReRaised
E1204.condition: Unhandled exception in a worker thread surfaced at the 'wait' barrier.
E1204.resolution: Inspect the '$trial' handle and handle the re-raise.

E1205.name: YieldOutsideCoroutine
E1205.condition: 'yield' used inside a non-coroutine static rule.
E1205.resolution: Declare the rule as a coroutine or remove 'yield'.

E1302.name: LayerNotFound
E1302.condition: 'draw' on an unattached or non-existent layer.
E1302.resolution: Attach the layer to the canvas first.

E1303.name: NegativeRadius
E1303.condition: Circle or polar point constructed with a negative radius r.

E1304.name: PolygonVertexUnderflow
E1304.condition: Polygon constructed with fewer than 3 vertex points.

E1305.name: CanvasRenderError
E1305.resolution: Retry with a valid canvas context.

E1401.name: FileNotFound
E1401.condition: Target file path missing during an open operation.
E1401.resolution: Create the file or correct the path.

E1402.name: FileAccessDenied
E1402.condition: Insufficient OS permissions to open or write a file handle.

E1403.name: UnclosedFileHandle
E1403.condition: Scope exited with an unclosed 'F' file handle.
E1403.resolution: Close the handle before scope exit.

E1404.name: LibraryNotFound
E1404.condition: Requested '$bee.sys' submodule not available in the runtime build.

E1405.name: InvalidFileMode
E1405.condition: File open mode is not 'r', 'w', 'a', or 'rw'.
E1405.resolution: Use one of the four accepted modes.
